portion_doctrine: Segments 121-122 are Adobe Premiere Pro tutorial content. Core material: video editing workflows, AI-powered masking, color correction, keyboard shortcuts, audio mixing, and composition techniques. Boilerplate stripped (ads, UI nav, attribution). REAL content: operating methods for video editors, production shortcuts, tool configurations.
operating_rules: Apply transitions where they visually make sense to avoid disorienting cuts
Use clip-level effects (Warm Flare, Grow, Shrink) to introduce motion without filming it
Pair effects with transitions strategically to guide viewer eye and improve flow
AI Object Mask tracks subjects forward and backward automatically; manual circle refinement for mask gaps
Drag Object Mask layer to Opacity property to apply cutout; use Expansion slider (-3.0) to choke inward, add feathering for natural blend
Color correction is exposure/cast fixing; color grading is style/mood (creative layer)
Use Lumetri Scopes as reference (highlight target: 90-100 on scope) while color-correcting clip-by-clip
Enable Comparison View in Program window to toggle reference clip against current clip frame-by-frame
LUT (Lookup Table) is preset; keep creative intensity 20-30 max to avoid oversaturation
Keyboard shortcuts > default panel navigation; assign Z=Add Edit, X=Ripple Delete for speed
Pancake editing: stack sequences vertically (purple line hover) to drag clips from selects to draft without switching tabs
Auto-level audio via Essential Sound panel > Loudness > Auto-Match for consistent volume
Enhance Speech slider reduces background noise; ducking auto-lowers music during dialog
Merge Clips audio sync via right-click menu; uses audio option for automatic alignment
Generative Extend uploads portion of media to generate new frames; content never used for AI training, stays private
Trim clips hold Alt/Option to ripple close gaps; white triangle indicates end of source media
named_methods: Pancake Editing: stack timelines vertically for efficient clip dragging between sequences
Ripple Delete: Alt/Option + Delete removes clip and shifts remaining forward automatically
Color Match: Lumetri Color panel > Color Wheels & Match > Comparison View > Apply Match to sync footage from different sources
Generative Extend: Toolbar tool, drag edit point forward, generates new frames based on source footage
Merge Clips: right-click selected video+audio clips > Merge Clips > Audio option for sync
Object Mask tracking: forward-backward button analyzes entire clip frame-by-frame with AI
Film Impacts Dashboard: Window > Extensions > Film Impact Dashboard for effect preview before apply
Chroma Blur: blur background with intensity slider for picture-in-picture depth
Surprise Me button: cycles through effect variations until desired look found
Keyframing Master Value: set stopwatch, adjust intensity at different timeline points for dynamic effects
tools: Lumetri Color panel: scopes, curves, color wheels, LUT library
Essential Sound panel: auto-match loudness, enhance speech, ducking, stock music
Lumetri Scopes: Waveform, Parade, Vectorscope views for color reference
Object Mask tool: Ellipse Mask variant for oval shapes, tracking buttons
Film Impacts extensions: Essential, Lights & Blurs, Motion, Tools categories
Keyboard shortcuts editor (menu: Keyboard Shortcuts) for custom mapping
Effect Controls panel for mask tracking and effect adjustment
Generative Extend powered by Adobe Firefly
Adobe Stock for source footage and music
